palette.notes: Frames: warm sunny midtones (ochre, rust, peach, cream) with teal-green and sky-blue shadows and skies; forest scenes in muted sage greens. Many hues but low saturation, so busy scenes stay calm.

lighting: Sprites drawn in Aseprite then lit in engine (Gii on MOAI) with 3D-style light and post effects (wiki). Frames show soft warm sun with long cool shadows, haze on the town, and low dim light on the dark interior/boss scenes.
silhouette: Big miner John and small white-haired girl Sam (wiki): in frames Sam's white hair and red outfit pop against brown rubble, so the small character still reads. Buildings and props are tall, stacked and irregular.

motion.timing: No frame timings measured. The review edit holds each scene ~2.7 s; motion visible is small ambient life (characters walking, steam, crowds) rather than big actions.

texture: Dense, hand-placed detail: shelves of objects, signs, pipes, stacked houses, foliage. Soft clusters, little hard outline, slight haze. Every corner has small unique props (wiki agrees).
camera: Top-down 3/4 view for gameplay; scenic shots look up at tall towers or across a crowded market from above. Slow pans; scene-to-scene cuts.
sound: Music by Joel Corelitz, audio by Hyperduck Soundworks; well received.

acting.enters: Characters walk in small through the scenery (top-down path through the forest); the boss scene shows Sam tiny at the bottom edge entering a huge wrecked set.
acting.acts: Roles split by body (wiki): John does heavy work, Sam supports and squeezes into gaps. In frames, NPCs do small chores in shops and market stalls as background life.
acting.depth: Tiny figures placed inside huge detailed sets; background crowds of small NPCs each doing something. The set is the hero, characters are small.

techniques: paint sprites flat, add light and post effects in the engine
warm lights with teal and blue shadows, low saturation overall
dense prop clutter so every corner has a story
background NPCs each doing a small chore
tiny hero with one bright accent (white hair, red) to stay findable
feel: warm hazy light + cluttered handmade set + tiny busy characters = cozy lived-in world
for_fred: Put Pixie small in the background doing a chore (pushing a box, poking a sign) while Fred does the main beat up front, then swap who is near and far. Keep one bright accent colour on whoever is tiny so the eye finds them.
